title: The impact of kindness
description: Kindness is a choice! When God nudges your heart toward an act of kindness, the ripple effect can change the world. Growing in compassion and empathy gives us a glimpse into the heart of God.

title: The truth about goodness
description: Do you believe that God is truly good? Where is He when we are suffering? The truth--He is the only one who can carry us through the darkest night. Then by His amazing grace, He calls us to rest in His goodness, not strive for perfection.

title: The blessings of faithfulness
description: Faithfulness is the key to abundant blessings! When we stand firm on God's promises amid difficult or hidden seasons, we will see His hand at work and receive preparation for whatever lies ahead.
